verdict.rationale: Adyen Uplift is documented as an in-product AI layer that gives "recommendations that are tailored for your business" and uses AI to optimize the payment funnel, including payment-optimization experiments and ML fraud detection trained on transaction data. That is Adyen's own capability for AI-driven suggestions from merchant data, but the evidence is a short product description. The MCP server is an external, locally run LLM client tool rather than in-product insights. missing for 10: detail on how insights and recommendations are surfaced inside the Customer Area, natural-language or explanatory insight generation over a merchant's own reporting data, breadth of insight types beyond payment optimization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
